title: Build a zero-state task board
summary: Create, automate, and extend a small local task-board application from an empty repository.

children.title: Choose the application architecture
children.description: Define the structure, state model, persistence approach, accessibility basics, and verification strategy for the supplied feature brief.
acceptanceCriteria: The artifact gives downstream tickets concrete implementation boundaries
The approach satisfies every runtime constraint in feature.md

children.title: Create the runnable application skeleton
children.description: Create the minimum application shell, package scripts, and deterministic test entry point without implementing task behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: npm start launches a page without runtime errors
npm test succeeds
The initial page has an accessible application heading and empty state

children.title: Create and display tasks
children.description: Implement the first vertical product slice: creating valid tasks and displaying the current list.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create non-empty tasks
Empty submissions are rejected
Created tasks appear immediately
npm test covers the new behavior and succeeds

children.title: Run verification in GitHub Actions
children.description: Add continuous integration that uses the package scripts established by the skeleton.
acceptanceCriteria: The workflow runs for pushes and pull requests
The workflow uses Node.js 22 and npm test
The workflow grants no more than read access to repository contents
No application or package files are modified

nodes.title: Complete, restore, and remove tasks
nodes.description: Extend the accepted task workflow with lifecycle controls while preserving task creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks can be completed and restored
Tasks can be removed
Task creation remains working
npm test covers the lifecycle behavior and succeeds

nodes.title: Persist task state
nodes.description: Store task data locally and recover safely during application startup.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks and completion state survive a browser reload
Invalid stored data does not break startup
All previously accepted behavior remains working
npm test covers persistence recovery and succeeds
